title: Multimodal Cognitive Workload n-back Task, 4 Difficulties
description: This dataset contains multimodal recordings from an n-back cognitive workload task with four difficulty levels (1-back to 4-back). It includes 19-channel mobile EEG, ECG, and Pupil Labs eye-tracking and pupillometry data, synchronized with Lab Streaming Layer. Twenty participants were recorded and 18 are released, with two excluded for data quality failures. The data were converted from XDF to BIDS.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a combined EEG+ECG mobile system using a 19-channel 10-20 montage, Ag/AgCl electrodes, a linked-ear reference and 250 Hz sampling. ECG used 3 leads on the same system. Pupil Labs Pupil Core captured pupillometry, and all streams were synchronized via LSL. The protocol had a tutorial phase with feedback (20 trials per level) and a main experiment of 100 trials per level (1-back to 4-back) without feedback. Each letter was shown for 1.0 s followed by a 0.7 s blank interval.
